title: Russian Attacks Kill 9, Injure 43 Across Ukraine, Including Kherson and Odesa Strikes
detail: Russian forces shelled and struck front-line and border regions across northern, eastern, and southern Ukraine over 24 hours, killing at least 9 civilians and injuring 43. In Kherson Oblast, Russian drones struck the village of Novokairy at around 05:30, killing two men aged 67 and 58; a further 9 people, including 2 police officers, were injured across the region. In Odesa Oblast, a jet-powered drone hit a shopping center and Russian forces again attacked port infrastructure, damaging a Togolese-flagged civilian vessel and injuring 4. Two Russian guided-bomb attacks hit Izium in Kharkiv Oblast, injuring 4, and 5 more were injured in a Dnipropetrovsk Oblast strike. The Ukrainian Air Force reported Russia attacked with 128 strike UAVs overnight.

title: Ukrainian Strike on Koloskovo Village, Belgorod Region, Kills 6
detail: A Ukrainian missile and drone strike hit the village of Koloskovo in Russia's Belgorod Oblast, roughly 15km from the Ukrainian border, killing at least 6 people and injuring 4, including a 14-year-old. Acting Belgorod Governor Alexander Shuvaev reported a structure caught fire and a vehicle was damaged. The strike came a day after large-scale reciprocal missile and drone exchanges between Russia and Ukraine that killed at least 19 people combined on both sides of the border.
